Dynacare workers ordered back to work in Manitoba

The Manitoba Labour Board has ordered striking Dynacare workers back to work. The order follows the commencement of a strike by the employees. Specific details regarding the duration of the strike or the terms of the labour dispute were not provided in the coverage.
